description:
These blue and white pool border tiles are a patterned strip for the waterline band of a swimming pool, the line where the water meets the coping, and they frame plain blue tiling below.

## How they look
The product photo shows a blue and white repeat with star-and-cross, Moroccan-style motifs. A busy pattern like this tends to draw the eye to the edge of the pool, so the main lining usually stays in one plain shade to let the border lead.

## Where they work
- **Pool waterline tiles**, as a continuous band just below the coping.
- **Step edges and benches**, where a patterned line helps mark a change in level.
- **Fountains and water features** in courtyards, as a small decorative frame.

The waterline is the part of a pool that sees the most splash, sun and scum build-up, which is why many owners pick a border that is easy to wipe. A star and cross pool border also hides small marks better than a flat light colour.

## Good to know
- Category: swimming pool tiles
- Pattern: blue and white, star-and-cross style (from the product photo)
- Size, thickness and finish are not listed online yet; confirm them with the sales team before you plan quantities.

Ask your contractor about a pool-grade adhesive and grout, and dry-lay a run of patterned pool edge tiles before fixing so the motif lines up at the corners.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715), check the blue in daylight and under water if you can, and get a dated quote for your pool. Browse the full [swimming pool tiles range](/categories/swimming-pool-tiles) for matching lining tiles.

faqs.q: What is the price of pool border tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the pattern, the area to cover and delivery, so send your pool measurements and city on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Where do pool border tiles go?
faqs.a: They are usually fixed as a band along the waterline, just below the coping, and sometimes along step edges. The band frames the plainer tiles that line the walls and floor of the pool.

faqs.q: Should the border match the main pool tiles?
faqs.a: Not exactly. A patterned border usually works best against one plain shade that picks up a colour from the pattern, such as a mid blue under a blue and white border.
